narration: I can add Rewind to my iPhone’s Home Screen, so it’s easy to open like an app.
I sign in as Maya, and Rewind opens her private group space.
I give the group a name, choose a prompt, and set a member limit. The group is private from the start.
Each invite code works once and expires after 24 hours. Jun uses it to join, and then appears in the member list.
I take a photo and choose a look before sealing it. Once it’s sealed, nobody can browse it before the film, including me.
Photos and videos draw from the same weekly allowance. The ledger shows what I’ve used and when something was added, while the content stays sealed.
Chat stays live while the capsule collects moments. Maya and Jun can exchange updates and react without revealing what’s inside.
I can opt in to a weekly reminder. It brings me back to add a small moment without needing to check the app all the time.
Here’s a completed capsule from Maya and Jun. Everyone’s sealed moments have become one shared film, ready for its premiere.
The film brings the group’s moments into one viewing experience. I can watch it again and then take the conversation back to Chat.
The film stays in our Archive after the premiere. I can open it and save an MP4 copy on my phone.
Priya isn’t a member of this group. Reusing Jun’s invite fails, and the private group doesn’t appear in her account.
